text:
olivia (AE): FYI Aether Labs requested a perf POC next week. Requirements: sustained 750 RPS chat, avg ~6 tokens/req, p95 <= 230ms. They also want a cost comparison (reserved pool vs autoscale burst) and a short note on HSM in-region (us-central1). Can we scope and schedule?
samir (SE): Yes. Proposal: two-model comparison (redwood-13b-q4 and redwood-open-7b) with warm prefix cache. Plan: 1h steady-state at 750 RPS (poisson) + a 15m 50% spike. Collect p50/p95/p99/p999, batch-size histogram, KV hit ratio, and per-request trace IDs.
dina (SRE): HSM constraint: customer wants keys in their HSM in us-central1. We'll run a stub that simulates key fetch latency to measure added RTT. Also confirm multi-AZ behavior; cross-az failover run in phase 2.
olivia (AE): They emphasized data residency and SOC2. Legal will follow up with questionnaire.
pete (Sales Ops): For quick pricing, baseline tokens/sec = 750 * 6 = 4500 t/s. I'll build reserved vs burst monthly rows and a break-even sensitivity for +/- 20% tokens. Need raw results for final numbers.
samir (SE): Load generator snippet to use (poisson + warmup):
```
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 750 --duration 60m \
  --arrival poisson --warmup 15m --pfx-cache warm --prompts aether_sample_prompts.json

# spike phase
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen --qps 1125 --duration 15m --ramp 20s --arrival poisson
```
Collect metrics: latency percentiles, batch size distribution, KV hit ratio, GPU util, and traces for any reqs > p95.
dina (SRE): Add: enable header X-RDW-TRACE and ensure sampling rate 100% for the run so we can correlate GPU batching timestamps to request latency. Also I'll run the HSM stub with three configs (no-cache, 50ms cache, 200ms TTL) to measure tradeoffs.
bench-bot: scheduled runs: smoke 2026-04-05T18:00Z; full runs 2026-04-06T09:00Z. Artifacts will post to https://ci.internal/redwood/aether/4781234567/artifacts.zip
olivia (AE): Action items: Samir = runbook + results writeup + heatmap, Pete = reserved vs burst pricing, Dina = HSM validation + security Q answers. Please post a one-pager for the customer with heatmap + concise recommended commit size.
samir (SE): I'll post a 1-page heatmap + a latency waterfall and results.json link after the full run. Plan: smoke Tue evening, full Wed morning. I'll also include an ops note recommending automatic fallback to 7b when p99 > threshold.
pete (Sales Ops): I'll draft three pricing lines: 1) 3-month reserved commit, 2) 12-month reserved commit, 3) on-demand burst. Will include sensitivity table for +/-20% token usage and a break-even graph.
dina (SRE): If HSM path adds >6ms median, we'll propose cached-key handle with documented security trade-offs. I'll surface any legal/cert blockers early.
olivia (AE): Great. Please keep updates here and tag me with results.json and artifacts link. We'll include the short security answers for quick review by the prospect. Thanks team :+1:
